text.en:
The provisions of Republic Act No. 1828 and any law to the contrary notwithstanding, the
President of the Philippines is hereby authorized to allow the development, exploitation and utilization of the
mineral deposits in the Surigao Mineral Reservation and the processing and disposition of the mineral that
may be produced therefrom by any citizens, corporation or association qualified under the Constitution, for a
period of not more than twenty-five (25) years, renewable for another twenty-five (25) years.

The grant of authority to develop, exploit and utilize mineral deposits in the Surigao Mineral
Reservation shall, for purposes of this Decree, be issued by the Secretary of Natural Resources subject to the
approval of the President of the Philippines. The provisions of Commonwealth Act No. 137 as amended, shall
apply to the grantee only in so far as the fees and taxes due the government are therein specified, the
provisions of law to the contrary notwithstanding.

All laws, decrees, orders and proclamations, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or amended accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 14th day of July, in the year of Our Lord nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
